title: Limits
code: Limit of a function: lim(x→a) f(x) = L
example: Find the limit of f(x) = 2x + 3 as x approaches 1: lim(x→1) (2x + 3) = 5.

title: Derivatives
code:
Derivative of xⁿ: d/dx(xⁿ) = n·x^(n-1)
Derivative of sin(x): d/dx[sin(x)] = cos(x)
Derivative of cos(x): d/dx[cos(x)] = -sin(x)
Derivative of eˣ: d/dx(eˣ) = eˣ
Derivative of ln(x): d/dx[ln(x)] = 1/x

title: Integrals
code:
Integral of xⁿ: ∫xⁿ dx = x^(n+1)/(n+1) + C
Integral of sin(x): ∫sin(x) dx = -cos(x) + C
Integral of cos(x): ∫cos(x) dx = sin(x) + C
Integral of eˣ: ∫eˣ dx = eˣ + C
Integral of 1/x: ∫(1/x) dx = ln|x| + C

title: Chain Rule
example: Find the derivative of f(x) = sin(2x): d/dx[sin(2x)] = 2·cos(2x).

title: Product Rule
code: d/dx[u(x) · v(x)] = u'(x) · v(x) + u(x) · v'(x)
example: Find the derivative of f(x) = x² * sin(x): d/dx[x² · sin(x)] = 2x · sin(x) + x² · cos(x).

title: Quotient Rule
code: d/dx( u(x)/v(x) ) = [v(x) · u'(x) - u(x) · v'(x)] / v(x)²
example: Find the derivative of f(x) = (x²)/(cos(x)): d/dx(x²/cos(x)) = [2x · cos(x) + x² · sin(x)] / cos²(x).

title: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
code: ∫ from a to b of f(x) dx = F(b) - F(a), where F'(x) = f(x)
example: Use the theorem to calculate the area under the curve of f(x) = x² from 0 to 2: ∫₀² x² dx = [x³/3]₀² = 8/3 - 0 = 8/3.
